dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 08, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Blue Jays Shut Down Giants 10-0, Cease Dominates**

The Toronto Blue Jays continued their strong start to the season, blanking the San Francisco Giants 10-0 behind a dominant performance from Dylan Cease. Cease threw 8 innings, striking out 11 and walking 3 while allowing just 1 hit. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense, going 2 for 5 with a home run and 4 RBIs. George Springer also homered for Toronto, his ninth of the season.

**Cubs Outlast Orioles 9-7 in Thrilling Finish**

The Chicago Cubs came from behind to defeat the Baltimore Orioles 9-7, thanks to a strong performance from Colin Rea and a late-inning rally. Pete Crow-Armstrong went deep twice for the Cubs, while Tyler O'Neill homered for the Orioles. The Cubs' bullpen held off a late Orioles charge to secure the win.

**Torkelson Homer Leads Tigers to 6-1 Win**

Spencer Torkelson's 15th home run of the season helped the Detroit Tigers defeat the Athletics 6-1. Torkelson's blast was part of a three-hit night for the Tigers' slugger, who also drove in three runs. Troy Melton pitched 5.1 innings of scoreless relief to earn the win.

**Braves Shut Down Pirates 3-0**

The Atlanta Braves continued their strong start to the season, blanking the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0 behind a strong performance from Jared Jones. Jones threw 6 shutout innings, striking out 8 and walking none. Joey Bart homered for the Braves, his first of the season.
